source_type: Newly generated G4-style animation key cels using built-in image_gen; not original show frames
processing: Original source RGB is preserved. Alpha core threshold 200 plus a 2-pixel original antialias fringe removes connected low-coverage generation halos; distant islands smaller than 1% of the largest component and farther than 4px are removed. All cels within a clip share a single scale and target box; optional registration uses integer translation only.
direction_normalization: gaze-idle and gaze-working whole-clip reflection; proud source indices 2 and 3 reflected as complete cels. No facial repainting or per-frame scaling.
